correctness.rationale: The direct-sum decomposition of Z[X]/Phi_{p^j} over Z[Y]/Phi_{p^{j-r}} is free on p^r monomials, and cokernel of multiplication by Y-1 is Z/p. Full rank plus this elementary cokernel forces exactly p^r Smith entries p, others one. Modulo m the fixed-point formula follows, and differences of exact fixed-point counts divided by length yield the complete cycle census for every p,j,m. The packaged verifier checks 102 exhaustive finite cases and 600 additional random vectors; finite checks are not used as proof.

originality.rationale: The exact prime and prime-power cycle counts are explicitly Conjectures 1 and 3 of Pudelko 2025 rather than proved theorems. The present work proves a stronger integer Smith-factor claim, fully explaining all fixed-point and cycle numbers. General prior Möbius inversion alone leaves these Smith invariants uncalculated; published and indexed comparisons found no covering result, with unindexed literature a residual risk.
residual_risks: An unindexed or differently named algebraic-dynamics work may already explicitly establish the same Smith normal form or fixed-point numbers.
Only the abstract of Moree 2005 was read, not the full body; its focus appears to be necklace formulas rather than these modular recurrence matrices.

value.rationale: The paper arxiv:2510.24882 explicitly presents prime and prime-power cyclotomic period-count formulas as Conjectures 1 and 3. The new theorem proves this natural infinite family uniformly for all moduli, provides previously unavailable integral Smith normal forms, and reveals complete shorter-cycle independence of prime-adic exponent; it is not a parameter renaming or isolated computational instance.
